User: In general, I'd rather sync feature branches with main using merge commits. Assistant: Got it. I'll default to merge commits when syncing a feature branch with main. agent.response:
Approach: merge commit (per your standing preference for syncing feature branches with main).

```bash
# Fetch the latest refs from origin so you have an up-to-date view of main.
git fetch origin

# Merge origin/main into your current feature branch, creating a merge commit since fast-forward is not possible.
git merge origin/main
```
